Growth momentum eases in October 
The Composite Output Index posted 52.1 in October, down 
from 52.4 in September. Remaining above the 50.0 no-change 
mark, the index has now signalled continuous monthly growth 
for just over a year. However, the degree to which output rose 
was the softest in four months as manufacturing production 
fell for the first time since June.

as new export orders returned to contraction. In turn, the
